description: Jet 4 MDB: DAO SELECT ... INTO with typed expressions + WHERE + ORDER BY into MT_Expr, and LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY + COUNT(*)/COUNT(col)/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX into MT_Agg, recording RecordsAffected. Keeps all pages before/after every MakeTable and Close; dumps created TableDefs field types/sizes/attributes, Indexes.Count, and rows.

question.description: Jet 4 MDB: DAO SELECT ... INTO with typed expressions + WHERE + ORDER BY into MT_Expr, and LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY + COUNT(*)/COUNT(col)/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX into MT_Agg, recording RecordsAffected. Keeps all pages before/after every MakeTable and Close; dumps created TableDefs field types/sizes/attributes, Indexes.Count, and rows.

args.text: SELECT ID, Qty * 2 AS DblQty, Qty * 1.5 AS FltVal, Price + 1 AS NewPrice, Cat & '-' & Name AS Tag, Null AS NullCol, CCur(Qty) AS CyQty, Qty > 15 AS BigFlag, IIf(Active, 'Y', 'N') AS ActStr INTO MT_Expr FROM Items WHERE Qty IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ID DESC

SELECT G.Cat, G.Label, COUNT(*) AS CntAll, COUNT(I.Qty) AS CntQty, SUM(I.Qty) AS SumQty, AVG(I.Price) AS AvgPrice, MIN(I.Dt) AS MinDt, MAX(I.Rate) AS MaxRate INTO MT_Agg FROM Groups AS G LEFT JOIN Items AS I ON G.Cat = I.Cat GROUP BY G.Cat, G.Label ORDER BY G.Cat
